issues.problem: ni-time contrast で: 'deadline-like limit' was vague and misleading.
issues.action: Rewrote: で gives time taken (一時間で終わる) or end point (今日で終わり).

issues.problem: ni-destination explain and へ contrast limited に/へ interchangeability to 行く・来る・帰る, while the examples used に/へ with 戻る and 留学する.
issues.action: Widened to verbs of going and coming (行く, 来る, 帰る, 戻る).

issues.problem: ni-recipient mistake 弟と本を貸しました is grammatical ('lent a book together with my brother'); the note did not explain why it fails.
issues.action: Note now says 弟と means 'together with my brother' and the receiver takes に.

issues.problem: ni-target rule said 触る takes に 'not を'. 絵を触る is standard modern Japanese, so the rule was false.
issues.action: Took 触る out of the rule, added a sentence to explain saying に and を are both standard with it, changed the example slot to に/を, and updated the を and と contrasts.

issues.problem: ni-frequency tip used '100 yen per person', which is normally 一人百円 or 一人につき百円, not に after a period.
issues.action: Replaced the tip: 'Twice a week', 'three hours a day': period + に + count.

issues.problem: ni-target contrast を said 'touching take に', which conflicts with the 触る fix.
issues.action: Changed to 'Entering, boarding, meeting and sitting take に.'
